Package neqsim.process.mpc

Class HorizonPlan

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mpc.HorizonPlan
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class HorizonPlan extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable result of one constrained process-linked MPC scan. Each row corresponds to one future sample. A failed scan contains no applicable moves or predictions.
Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim contributors

  • Constructor Details

    • HorizonPlan

      HorizonPlan(HorizonPlan.Status status, double[][] plannedMvs, double[][] predictedCvs, double[][] lowerSlack, double[][] upperSlack)
      Snapshot a completed scan.
      Parameters:
      status - solver outcome
      plannedMvs - absolute MV sequence, with the last move held past the control horizon
      predictedCvs - future CV measurements
      lowerSlack - shortfalls below the CV soft lower bounds
      upperSlack - excesses above the CV soft upper bounds
